regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: The DOS EXE header, rebuilt by the museum's unpacker after removing the DIET compression.

regions.label: Header gap
regions.note: Four zero bytes before the relocation table.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: One address: the word at 0621h, where the handler keeps its own segment.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Zeros that round the header up to a 16-byte paragraph.

regions.label: Font file loader
regions.note: Opens ARAB-ART.FNT and reads exactly 4F28h bytes to 06C3h; on an error it prints a message and exits.

regions.label: Install check and hook
regions.note: The same DALYASSER check and INT 10h hook as version 4.15.

regions.label: Handler
regions.note: The 4.15 engine with its addresses moved.

regions.label: State
regions.note: Colors, font, cursor and style flags.

regions.label: File name
regions.note: "ARAB-ART.FNT", the font file the loader opens.

regions.label: VGA tables
regions.note: Segment A000h, the bit-reversal table and the pixel masks, as in 4.15.

regions.label: Placeholder
regions.note: 128 bytes that the font file overwrites; 17 spaces where the file has "YASSER DOT DESIGN".

regions.label: Space for the fonts
regions.note: Zeros in the EXE. At start-up ARAB-ART.FNT fills it with the key table and fonts, at the same addresses.

regions.label: Banner
regions.note: The 7.15 banner, printed if the font file cannot be loaded.

regions.label: Zeros
regions.note: Inside the space the font file overwrites.

regions.label: Zeros
regions.note: The last bytes the font file overwrites.

regions.label: Banner and exit
regions.note: Prints the banner from 54FBh, text that only the font file provides, then stays resident.

regions.label: Zeros
regions.note: Zero bytes at the end of the image.

routines.name: load_fnt
routines.note: Reads the font file into its own memory.

lines.note: Read 4F28h bytes, the exact file size
Banner at 54FBh, filled from the font file
